parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-04 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 4201.4 | 5.06 | 5.06
2 | 2238.9 | 4.35 | 9.41
3 | 343.9 | 31.91 | 41.32
4 | 25.0 | 0.99 | 42.31
5 | 10.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as H-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-04
Curve type: H-type
Aquifer depth: 41.32 – >42.31 m
Recommendation: Drill to a minimum target depth of 50 m to sufficiently penetrate the highly conductive saturated zone identified below 41.3 m. Ensure adequate casing is installed through the upper 9.4 m of resistive overburden to prevent borehole collapse.
